trigger: schedule: daily 08:00 Europe/Ljubljana (manual for this proof run)
inputs: overdue invoices (id, amount, currency, dueDate, daysOverdue, customerName, customerEmail) — seeded from inputs/invoices.json; in production, Stripe read-only 'invoices where status=open AND due_date<today'
actions: 2. for each, draft a polite-but-firm Slovene payment-reminder email via Claude
3. write each draft to drafts/ for human approval (NO send)
outputs: one reminder draft per invoice in drafts/<invoiceId>.txt + drafts/_manifest.json; production: Gmail Drafts + a log row

guardrails.sends: 0 — the agent has NO send code path (least-privilege by construction)
guardrails.leastPrivilege: drafting only; stripe:read (not write); gmail:draft (not send)

hitl: send step: a named human reviews each draft and sends manually — the agent never sends
verify: given 3 seeded overdue invoices, produces exactly 3 drafts, each correctly naming its customer and its EUR amount and asking for payment, and performs 0 sends; cost under cap
